exact_statement: For every integer r>=12 let m=r^2 and G=K_r disjoint union m edges, C its independent-set indicator, f=1-2C, s=EC and I the actual total influence. Use the ORIGINAL complete edge-occupation source with fixed clique edge activities 1/(r-1), isolated-edge activities 0<lambda_j<=1, all root/attachment factors and full normalization, and actual empty/nonempty calibration. Define kappa_dil=sum_j Pr_{fhat^2}(S meets isolated edge j) log2(1/lambda_j)/I=s sum_j log2(1/lambda_j)/I. Then the ENTIRE reference cross-entropy is at most (259/32+kappa_dil) I. Local activities lambda_j=1 give kappa_dil=0 and CE<=259I/32<9I despite indispensable positive-DNF maximum read r-1 tending to infinity. In contrast the globally feasible uniform scale lambda_e=1/Delta=1/(r-1) gives complete CE/I>=(2/3)log2(r-1), which diverges on the SAME actual all-relevant Boolean family. Full H(f)/I<6, so this refutes universal payment of the globally uniform occupation source, not FEI. The exact influence is s[(4/3)r^2+2r(r-1)/(r+1)]. Both normalizers, all label/root/attachment costs and the empty wrapper are retained. For m disjoint edges alone the exact full nonempty-cost ratio is (3/4)log2(1/lambda)+(1/2)log2(32)+(1/4)log2(48)+3[1-(3/4)^m]log2[(1+lambda/12)^m-1]/m; its lambda dependence cancels at m=1. The repaired root, with general projected/calibrated references, retains all actual full-CE decrease bookings and both full terminals on every finite stopping tree. No refreshed history budget or arbitrary-query fee payment is asserted. Arbitrary connected overlaps and full FEI remain open.
